items.name: command-move
items.subject: MOVE: one sturdy armoured boot of dark leather with a polished steel toe cap and greave, striding toward the upper right, seen from the side. Nothing else.

items.name: command-attack
items.subject: ATTACK: one broad straight sword, its blade pointing to the upper right at 45 degrees, a polished steel blade with one bright edge highlight, a simple bronze crossguard and a dark leather grip at the lower left.

items.name: command-stop
items.subject: STOP: one flat octagonal steel plate seen head-on, like a stop sign in shape, with a thick polished bronze rim and one bold horizontal bar raised across its centre.

items.name: command-hold
items.subject: HOLD POSITION: one tall steel tower shield standing upright and still, seen from the front, its pointed foot planted, a single bronze boss in its centre. Nothing else.

items.name: command-patrol
items.subject: PATROL: two thick curved steel arrows chasing each other around an empty circle, forming one closed loop, their bronze heads bold and clear.

items.name: command-follow
items.subject: FOLLOW: two identical bold steel arrowheads, one directly behind the other with a small gap, both pointing to the upper right, the leading one slightly larger.

items.name: command-build
items.subject: BUILD: one builder's hammer alone, a plain dark iron head and a plain wooden handle wrapped in brown leather, angled diagonally from the lower left to the upper right, simple and sturdy.

items.name: command-build-advanced
items.subject: BUILD ADVANCED STRUCTURE: the same builder's hammer made better, a master builder's hammer: its head now polished bright steel bound with two bright brass bands, the handle dark polished wood with a brass cap and a royal-blue grip wrap.

items.name: command-produce
items.subject: PRODUCE (train a unit): one dark iron anvil seen from the front-left, a single orange-hot glowing ingot lying on it. Only the anvil and the ingot.

items.name: command-rally
items.subject: SET RALLY POINT: one small swallow-tailed cream cloth flag on a straight steel pole, the cloth streaming to the right, the pole planted upright.

items.name: command-pause
items.subject: PAUSE PRODUCTION: two thick upright polished steel bars side by side with bevelled edges and bronze end caps.

items.name: command-cancel
items.subject: CANCEL: one bold X of two crossed thick bars enamelled deep red, with polished steel edges and one bronze rivet at the crossing.

items.name: command-camera
items.subject: JUMP CAMERA TO SELECTION: one brass spyglass, extended, angled diagonally toward the upper right, its round lens glinting deep blue.

items.name: command-upgrade
items.subject: UPGRADE BUILDING: one broad, thick polished steel arrow pointing straight up, with a smaller bronze chevron floating just above its tip.
items.title: Upgrade

items.name: command-research
items.subject: RESEARCH: one round magnifying lens with a thick polished brass rim and a short leather-wrapped handle, angled diagonally, its glass catching one bright highlight.
items.title: Research

items.name: command-garrison
items.subject: GARRISON (enter a building): one stout closed arched door of dark steel-banded wood, studded with bronze rivets, seen head-on, a bold steel arrow pointing into it from the left.
items.title: Garrison

items.name: command-unload
items.subject: UNLOAD (leave a building): one stout arched door of dark steel-banded wood standing open, seen head-on, a bold steel arrow pointing out of its dark doorway toward the lower right.
items.title: Unload

items.name: command-learn
items.subject: LEARN HERO SKILL: two thick stacked chevrons pointing up, like a rank insignia, in polished gold with steel edges.
items.title: Learn skill

items.name: stat-armor-light
items.subject: LIGHT ARMOUR: one simple padded leather jerkin seen from the front, laced at the chest, warm brown leather with bronze buckles.

items.name: stat-armor-heavy
items.subject: HEAVY ARMOUR: one polished steel breastplate seen from the front with bronze rivets and a raised centre ridge.

items.name: stat-armor-structure
items.subject: FORTIFIED (structure armour): one short segment of a crenellated grey stone wall, seen from the front-left, its blocks big and clean.
